title: ISMIP7 Antarctic Ocean Melt Calibration
description: A compilation of ocean-model output, hydrographic observations, and observational melt-rate estimates used by the ISMIP7 Antarctic Ice Sheet ocean focus group to calibrate sub-ice-shelf melt parameterisations, along with derived calibration targets, drainage-basin numbers, buttressing-flux-response numbers, and ice-shelf/floating-ice masks on standardised ISMIP7 grids.

## data__README.md
# ISMIP7 Antarctic ocean melt calibration data

Data for calibrating sub-ice-shelf melt parameterisations for the ISMIP7 Antarctic
experiments, collected by the ISMIP7 AIS ocean focus group. The datasets are described
in the AIS ocean protocol presentations (November 2025, Copenhagen March 2026, EGU 2026)
and the ISMIP7 Protocol Cheat Sheet, and are used by the focus group's calibration
toolbox.

Most of what is here is third-party ocean-model output and observations, redistributed
with the permission of the groups who produced it. **Each dataset carries its own licence
and citation.** The table below gives the licence for every directory; each directory
also has a `README.md` with the full citation for every file in it. The licence texts
are in [`LICENSES/`](LICENSES/).

| Directory | Contents | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ocean_modelling_data/` | Ocean-model temperature, salinity, thermal forcing and melt rates for "cold" and "warm" cavity states, from five modelling groups, plus the derived calibration targets (term 3) | CC-BY-4.0 for Mathiot, Jourdain, Timmermann and Haid; **CC-BY-NC-4.0** for Naughten and for files that combine Naughten output with other models — see the directory README |
| `ocean_observations_data/` | Amundsen Sea hydrographic sections from the MISOMIP2 MIPkit-A, on the ISMIP7 8 km / 60 m grid, plus the derived calibration target (term 4) | Compiled from cruise data of several institutes; see the directory README for provenance |
| `meltobs/` | Observed basal melt rates per IMBIE2 basin from Paolo et al. (2023), Davison et al. (2023) and Adusumilli et al. (2020), plus the derived calibration target (term 2) | CC-BY-4.0 for Davison and Adusumilli; Paolo et al. is a NASA MEaSUREs product with no licence stated |
| `imbie2/` | IMBIE2 drainage-basin numbers on the ISMIP7 grids, from the MEaSUREs Antarctic Boundaries dataset | NASA MEaSUREs product, no licence stated; cite Mouginot et al. (2017) |
| `bfrns/` | Buttressing-flux-response numbers of Reese et al. (2018) on the ISMIP7 grids | CC-BY-4.0 |
| `floatingmasks/` | Floating-ice masks on the ISMIP7 grids, derived from Bedmap3 | CC-BY-4.0 (Bedmap3's licence) |
| `shelfmask/` | Ice-shelf identifiers on the 8 km grid: the PICO shelf mask of a PISM run on BedMachine Antarctica geometry | BedMachine Antarctica states no restrictions on access or use |

The ISMIP7-produced files (the `melt_*_target_term*.nc` calibration targets, the
regridded masks) are derivatives of the datasets above and are shared under the same
terms as their sources; where a source is CC-BY-NC-4.0 the derivative is too.

## Citing

Please cite the original dataset for anything you use from here — the citations are in
each directory's `README.md` — and the ISMIP7 AIS ocean protocol paper (submitted to
*The Cryosphere*, 2026) for the calibration method.

## Licences

- `LICENSES/CC-BY-4.0.txt` — Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International,
  https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
- `LICENSES/CC-BY-NC-4.0.txt` — Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0
  International, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/

## Contact

ISMIP7 AIS ocean focus group, via the ISMIP discussion board:
https://github.com/orgs/ismip/discussions


## data__bfrns__README.md
# Buttressing flux response numbers

`BFRN_ismip{1,2,4,8,16,32,64}km_v2.nc`: the buttressing flux response numbers of
Reese et al. (2018) on the ISMIP7 grids, used to define the buttressing regions in the
melt calibration.

## Licence

CC-BY-4.0 (Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International), with the agreement of the
authors. The licence text is in `../LICENSES/CC-BY-4.0.txt`. Please cite:

- Reese, R., Gudmundsson, G. H., Levermann, A. and Winkelmann, R. (2018). The far reach of ice-shelf thinning in Antarctica. *Nature Climate Change*, 8, 53–57. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41558-017-0020-x


## data__floatingmasks__README.md
# Floating-ice masks

`floatingmask_ismip{1,2,4,8,16,32,64}km.nc`: 1 where ice is floating (ice shelves),
0 elsewhere, on the ISMIP7 grids. Derived by the ISMIP7 AIS ocean focus group from
Bedmap3 conservatively regridded to the 8 km grid (floating fraction > 0.5), and
remapped to the other resolutions by nearest neighbour.

## Licence

CC-BY-4.0 (Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International), following Bedmap3. The
licence text is in `../LICENSES/CC-BY-4.0.txt`. Please cite:

- Pritchard, H. D. et al. (2025). Bedmap3 updated ice bed, surface and thickness gridded datasets for Antarctica. *Scientific Data*, 12, 414. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-025-04672-y
- Pritchard, H. et al. (2024). BEDMAP3 – Ice thickness, bed and surface elevation for Antarctica – gridding products [Data set]. NERC EDS UK Polar Data Centre. https://doi.org/10.5285/2d0e4791-8e20-46a3-80e4-f5f6716025d2


## data__imbie2__README.md
# IMBIE2 drainage basins

`basin_numbers_ismip{1,2,4,8,16,32,64}km_v2.nc`: the IMBIE2 Antarctic drainage basins
rasterised onto the ISMIP7 grids by the ISMIP7 AIS ocean focus group. The basins come
from the MEaSUREs Antarctic Boundaries dataset of Mouginot, Scheuchl and Rignot; the
same basins on the 8 km ocean grid are in `/ISMIP7/AIS/obs/ocean/IMBIE-basins/`.

## Licence

NASA MEaSUREs product. The data are freely available; the provider states no licence.
Please cite:

- Mouginot, J., Scheuchl, B. and Rignot, E. (2017). MEaSUREs Antarctic Boundaries for IPY 2007–2009 from Satellite Radar, Version 2 [Data set]. NASA National Snow and Ice Data Center Distributed Active Archive Center. https://doi.org/10.5067/AXE4121732AD


## data__meltMIP__README.md
# meltMIP inputs

Inputs for the ISMIP7 sub-ice-shelf melt intercomparison (meltMIP): the observed
Southern Ocean climatology on the ISMIP7 8 km / 60 m grid with a set of perturbations,
CESM2-WACCM ssp585 ocean forcing for three 21-year windows, and the MISOMIP2 ocean
topography.

## Files, sources and licences

| Files | What they are | Source | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `OI_Climatology_ismip8km_60m_{so,tf,thetao}_extrap.nc` | Salinity, thermal forcing and potential temperature of the OCEAN ICE Southern Ocean climatology, extrapolated under the ice shelves. Identical to the files in `/ISMIP7/AIS/obs/ocean/climatology/zhou_annual_06_nov/` | Zhou et al., OCEAN ICE Southern Ocean Climatology (SEANOE) | CC-BY-4.0 |
| `OI_Climatology_ismip8km_60m_{so,tf,thetao}_extrap_perturbation*.nc` | The same climatology with a uniform temperature perturbation (`0.5K`, `1.0K`, `2.0K`, `4.0K`) or a vertical shift of the thermocline (`tc±100m`, `tc±200m`), prepared by the ISMIP7 AIS ocean focus group | Derived from the above | CC-BY-4.0 |
| `{so,tf,thetao}_Oyr_CESM2-WACCM_ssp585_r1i1p1f1_ismip8km_60m_{2079-2099,2179-2199,2279-2299}.nc` | CESM2-WACCM ssp585 ocean forcing, bias-corrected and extrapolated as in the ISMIP7 AIS ocean protocol, for three 21-year windows | ISMIP7 AIS ocean focus group; the full forcing is in `/ISMIP7/AIS/CESM2-WACCM/ssp585/ocean/` | As for the ISMIP7 forcing datasets, which carry no separate licence |
| `MISOMIP2_topography/MISOMIP2_Ocean-x2f.nc` | MISOMIP2 ocean topography | De Rydt et al. (2023), MIPkit-Perturbations (MISOMIP2); see `MISOMIP2_topography/LICENSE.txt` | CC-BY-4.0 |

The licence texts are in the `LICENSES/` directory next to `parameterisations/ocean/` on Globus (the top of the melt-calibration collection on Source Cooperative).

## data__meltobs__README.md
# Observed basal melt rates

`Melt_Paolo_Davison_Adusumilli_imbie2.csv` gives the observed basal melt rate and its
uncertainty per IMBIE2 basin, combining three satellite-derived melt-rate products;
`melt_target_term2_v3.nc` is the calibration target derived from it by the ISMIP7 AIS
ocean focus group.

## data__ocean_modelling_data__README.md
# Ocean-model calibration data

Temperature (`_T`), salinity (`_S`), thermal forcing (`_TF`) and basal melt rate (`_m`)
from regional and circum-Antarctic ocean models, for a "cold" and a "warm" cavity
state, regridded to the ISMIP7 8 km / 60 m grid by the ISMIP7 AIS ocean focus group.
`melt_cold_target_term3_v2.nc` and `melt_warm_target_term3_v2.nc` are the calibration
targets derived from them.

The variable names follow the ISMIP7 CMIP forcing datasets (updated 31 July 2026).

| `Jourdain-Naughten_NEMO-MITgcm_{cold,warm}_{T,S,TF,m}.nc` | Amundsen Sea: Jourdain et al. (2022), NEMO. Weddell Sea: Naughten et al. (2021), MITgcm | The Amundsen Sea part is CC-BY-4.0 and the Weddell Sea part is CC-BY-NC-4.0, so **the combined files are CC-BY-NC-4.0** |

## data__ocean_observations_data__README.md
# Ocean-observation calibration data

Hydrographic sections of the Amundsen Sea for thirteen years between 1994 and 2020
(`Obs_YEAR_T.nc`, `_S.nc`, `_TF.nc`: temperature, salinity, thermal forcing), on the
ISMIP7 8 km / 60 m grid, and the calibration target derived from them
(`melt_observations_target_term4.nc`).

The files were renamed from `Dutrieux_ismip8km_60m_*` to `Obs_YEAR_*` on 31 July 2026.

## Provenance

The sections are the Amundsen Sea observations compiled for MISOMIP2 MIPkit-A
(De Rydt et al., 2024) by Pierre Dutrieux, gridded onto the ISMIP7 grid by the ISMIP7
AIS ocean focus group. From the MIPkit-A description:

> The hydrographic properties provided on horizontal sections at 15 depths come from the
> CTD measurements obtained during cruises of the following icebreaker research vessels:
> Nathaniel B. Palmer (United States Antarctic Program), James C. Ross (British Antarctic
> Survey and Natural Environment Research Council), Araon (Korea Polar Research
> Institute), Oden (Swedish Polar Research) and Polarstern (Alfred Wegener Institute,
> Germany). In this MIPkit, we have gathered data for the first months of 1994, 2000,
> 2007, 2009 (Jacobs, 1994, 2000, 2007, 2009), 2010 (Swedish Polar Research Secretariat
> 2010; Gohl 2015), 2012 (Kim et al. 2012), 2014 (Heywood 2014; Ha et al. 2014), 2016
> (Kim et al. 2016), 2017 (Gohl 2017), 2018 (Kim et al. 2018), 2019 (Larter et al. 2019)
> and 2020 (Wellner, 2020).

The underlying cruise data come from several institutes, some of it never formally
published, and no single licence covers the compilation, so none is attached here:
please treat these files as a convenience for calibration and cite the cruises and
papers below for anything you publish. The cruise DOIs are cited in De Rydt et al.
(2024) wherever one exists. The same observations are shown in Dutrieux et al. (2014),
Jenkins et al. (2018) and Joughin et al. (2021).

## data__shelfmask__README.md
# Ice-shelf identifiers

`shelf_mask_ismip8km.nc`: an integer identifier for each ice shelf on the ISMIP7 8 km
grid (0 elsewhere), used to aggregate melt rates per shelf. It is the PICO shelf mask of
a PISM diagnostic run (PISM 2.2.2, March 2026) by the ISMIP7 AIS ocean focus group, on
geometry from BedMachine Antarctica regridded to the ISMIP 8 km grid (the file records
the source as BedMachine but not which release; the current one is v3).

## Licence

BedMachine Antarctica is distributed by NSIDC with no restrictions on access or use.
Please cite:

- Morlighem, M. et al. (2020). Deep glacial troughs and stabilizing ridges unveiled beneath the margins of the Antarctic ice sheet. *Nature Geoscience*, 13, 132–137. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41561-019-0510-8
- Morlighem, M. (2022). MEaSUREs BedMachine Antarctica, Version 3 [Data set]. NASA National Snow and Ice Data Center Distributed Active Archive Center. https://doi.org/10.5067/FPSU0V1MWUB6
